questions.question: Define diffusion and osmosis. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• Define diffusion and osmosis.
  • Answer: Diffusion: Movement of molecules from high to low concentration.
  • Osmosis: Movement of water across a semipermeable membrane toward higher solute
  • concentration. (CO1, K)
